description: This file defines the interface and macros for ARM Cortex-M MPU (Memory Protection Unit) configuration within Zephyr RTOS, including functions for static and dynamic MPU region setup, memory partition management, and user space validation.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure_static_mpu_regions
methods.description: Configures static MPU regions during system initialization.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_mark_areas_for_dynamic_regions
methods.description: Marks memory areas as eligible for dynamic MPU region configuration.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure_dynamic_mpu_regions
methods.description: Configures dynamic MPU regions at runtime.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_mem_partition_config_update
methods.description: Updates access permissions of an active memory partition.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure
methods.description: Configures an MPU region with specified type, base, and size.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure_mem_domain
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for a memory domain.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure_user_context
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for a user thread context.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_configure_mem_partition
methods.description: Configures a single memory partition MPU region.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_mem_partition_remove
methods.description: Removes or resets a MPU region for a memory partition.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_get_max_available_dyn_regions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of available dynamic MPU regions.

methods.name: arm_core_mpu_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a buffer is user accessible.
